## Listing

<!-- What are you listing, and is this a new listing, an update or a removal? -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I made this asset, or I have the author's permission to list it
- [ ] It's free to download from the repository's releases
- [ ] It works with the FivePRS version in `minVersion` (or the latest release if not set)
- [ ] It doesn't include anything I don't have the rights to share (game files, paid assets, other people's models)
- [ ] I've read the [listing rules](https://github.com/FivePRS/registry#rules)
